propositions: CPython 3.12+ emits DeprecationWarning when fork is called in a multithreaded host, and Python 3.14 no longer defaults to fork; the grounding harness hard-codes fork context causing deadlock risk warnings in multithreaded environments
The harness must default to spawn for cross-platform safety while accepting optional caller-supplied multiprocessing context for informed fork usage in single-threaded scenarios

Worker callables must be importable module-level names with pickleable args, kwargs, and return values; non-importable or non-pickleable inputs and parent unpickling failures must return RunResult(abstain_reason='other') without raising
The fix preserves the never-raise fail-open contract for process start, pickling, receive, and unpickling failures while maintaining compatibility with existing lifecycle and mutation test suites
